text:
maria: PSA — release cutoff in ~2h for v0.23.0. Please add changelog one-liners to keep-a-changelog/2026-03.md and run `scripts/changelog-lint` before merging. Include PR number.

devon: Can someone paste the exact one-liner template? Also, imperative voice or past tense?

maria: Imperative voice please — short, include component tag and PR number. Example: 

```
runtime: improve KV-cache eviction to reduce memory spikes (PR #7890)
```

devon: thx. Does the lint enforce component tag? my PR failed with "missing component tag" error.

sam: Yep lint is strict there. Tag should be the top-level component: e.g., `runtime`, `api`, `console`, `docs`.

lina: Quick copy of the minimal template to paste into your entry file: 

```
- <component>: <short imperative one-liner> (PR #<number>)
```

release-bot: Reminder automated: if you want an automated bump PR I can open one on merge. Run `/bump 0.23.0` in the release channel or request me here.

devon: One more question — where should the file live? I accidentally put mine in docs/CHANGELOG.md.

maria: Put entries in `keep-a-changelog/2026-03.md` for this release. We compile that into the release notes at publish time.

sam: Also note branch policy: main is feature-frozen at cutoff. For hotfixes after cutoff use `release/0.23` branch and tag PRs with `release-candidate`.

devon: Got it. Are internal-only items allowed?

maria: They are allowed but mark them `[internal]` at the start of the line so release tooling can filter.

lina: I'm fixing my lint errors now, will push a tiny change in ~10m.

sam: Pushed my one-liner: `runtime: improve KV-cache eviction to reduce memory spikes (PR #7890)` — please include in the build.

maria: Great — if everyone follows the template and runs the linter we'll be able to auto-build release notes. I'll run a quick sweep 10 minutes before cutoff and post a compiled list. :thumbsup:

devon: thanks — pinging reviewers for quick approvals.

lina: ok done, lint green.

release-bot: Bump PR queued for 0.23.0 (will open when at least 2 release approvals are present).

maria: excellent. if you hit any edge cases ping me directly and paste the failing `yarn changelog:lint` output.

sam: one tiny nit — please keep one-liners to <= 120 chars so summaries don't wrap badly.

maria: noted. Cutting it down to 80-100 chars preferred. Thanks everyone!
